::: {#exr-exp-score-fn}
#### Score function of an exponential variable

Derive the score function for a single exponential random variable $X$,
with respect to the mean parameter $\pmean$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-exp-score-fn}

The exponential density with mean $\pmean$ is
$\p(X = x) = \pmean^{-1} e^{-x/\pmean}$ for $x > 0$,
so $\loglik = \llexpmean$, and:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\score
&\eqdef \deriv{\pmean}\loglik
&& \text{(definition of the score)}\\
&= \deriv{\pmean}\paren{\llexpmean}
&& \text{(exponential log-likelihood)}\\
&= \deriv{\pmean}\paren{-\logf{\pmean} - x \pmean^{-1}}
&& \text{(write $\frac{x}{\pmean}$ as $x \pmean^{-1}$)}\\
&= -\deriv{\pmean}\logf{\pmean} - x \deriv{\pmean} \pmean^{-1}
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= -\frac{1}{\pmean} - x \deriv{\pmean} \pmean^{-1}
&& \text{(derivative of $\log \pmean$)}\\
&= -\frac{1}{\pmean} - x \paren{-\pmean^{-2}}
&& \text{(power rule)}\\
&= -\frac{1}{\pmean} + \frac{x}{\pmean^2}
&& \text{(multiply)}\\
&= -\frac{\pmean}{\pmean^2} + \frac{x}{\pmean^2}
&& \text{(write both terms over the common denominator)}\\
&= \frac{x - \pmean}{\pmean^2}
&& \text{(combine the fractions)}\\
&= \frac{x - \E{X}}{\pmean^2}
&& \text{($\E{X} = \pmean$)}\\
&= \frac{x - \E{X}}{\Var{X}}
&& \text{($\Var{X} = \pmean^2$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
